svg.title: japonisme gig poster
svg.text: AVAILABLE FROM THE ANCHOR ROOMS BAR OR PALLIGHTPRO.CO.UK

g.data-flaw: The cream CARVER & was never detected, so the headline is one red line, and the large THE ANCHOR ROOMS is set small.
g.data-outlook: Fixable: light type on dark paper beside a coloured line needs better detection, and the venue's size step should be kept.
